headline: Argentina Authorizes Coto to Export Bovine Byproducts to European Union
summary: Argentina's food safety agency, Senasa, has authorized the supermarket chain Coto to export inedible bovine tallow to the European Union, marking the first such shipment since November 2023.
why: The resumption of agricultural exports to the EU is a positive development for Argentina's trade balance and the domestic agribusiness sector.

impacts.name: Coto
impacts.why: New export authorization opens a new revenue stream.
